name: mcp-questionnaire
description: Gather Decisions — structured input surfaces inside the Claude conversation (MCP App). See DESIGN.html.

scripts.//: The UI bundle IS the Worker's assets directory (packages/ui/dist), so every script that runs or ships the Worker builds the UI first. `build` is the ordering, in one place.
scripts.dev: pnpm build && pnpm --filter @mcpq/worker exec wrangler dev
scripts.deploy: pnpm build && pnpm --filter @mcpq/worker exec wrangler deploy
scripts.check: pnpm build && pnpm --filter @mcpq/worker exec wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir packages/worker/.wrangler/dry-run
